• <b>Quadros/s igual aos Hz do monitor</:
• Frames/s equal to the monitor's Hz: the test is in sync. If it's lower, enable the monitor's max refresh rate (above) or close heavy programs.
• Follow the object with your eyes: a dark trail behind it is ghosting (slow panel); a light or colored outline is overshoot (overdrive too strong) — most visible on the 50% gray background.
• Pixels per frame = speed ÷ frames per second. The lower, the smoother: at 240 Hz and 960 px/s the object moves 4 px per frame; at 60 Hz, 16 px.
• 1/2 and 1/4 bands show how the same motion looks with half and a quarter of the frames.
